intent: Add strict read-only list_connections and get_connection MCP queries with stable filters and pagination, complete supported semantic and DI fields, document revision, and connection-bound geometry revision tokens without changing existing element query contracts.
appliedFixes: Bound each geometry revision digest to its connection ID so tokens cannot be replayed across connections without BPMNEdges.
Exercised get_connection in the read-only no-persistence contract.
Covered unknown connection lookup without memory, revision, or disk changes.

learnings.searched: docs/solutions for MCP, schema, connection, pagination, server, and handler patterns

agentNative.notes: Both query primitives are advertised through tools/list, expose strict schemas and rich verification state, use the shared active diagram, and are described in pagination instructions.

simplicity.notes: The implementation reuses existing pagination, validation, result parsing, stable sort, and resource-limit patterns; no new engine abstraction or persistent model was added.

verification: focused contract, integration, resource-limit, and request-validation suites
compiled stdio e2e schema fingerprint and structured-output suite
verdict: Ready to merge; repository-wide contributor test gate passed
